notes:
High-priority evaluation for low-latency inference across their trading alert pipeline and customer chat.
- Company background: proprietary event stream (sub-ms ordering timestamps) + customer messaging; strict SLAs for market signals.
- Main ask: consistent p99 latency <= 20-30ms for short-form chat and reranking (payloads ~80-300 tokens); sustained throughput ~1.5-2k req/s during US peak.
- Cost posture: very cost-sensitive at scale — target unit cost < $0.0006/token-equivalent (internal calc). Looking for batching/caching/quantization levers.
- Model preference: prefer to serve a quantized 13B/7B variant for production with canary of 70B quantized for higher-quality routes. Open to Redwood-verified quant profiles.
- Routing/fallback: need deterministic fallback rules — primary: low-quantized 13B on dedicated; fallback: smaller 7B on private nodes; overflow: queued short-lived GPU bursts.
- Caching strategy: heavy reuse of prefix + KV-cache for sessioned agents; want automatic prefix cache TTL controls.
- Benchmarking asks: provide a perf harness to run continuous load with realistic token distributions, p50/p95/p99 reports, and cost modeling per config (batch size, quant level, KV cache hit rate).
- Security/compliance: must run in VPC w/ KMS integration, SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs forwarded to their Splunk cluster, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-08): "We need repeatable perf numbers — if p99 spikes above 25ms we can't use it for signal routing."
- POC status: initial smoke on hosted API successful (latency ~40-60ms with default configs). Next: Dedicated POC for quantized 13B with strict batching/caching controls.
- Action items so far: se-led perf questionnaire completed; security info request submitted; infra asked for benchmark harness by 2026-03-10.
- Internal notes: procurement expects a 3-6 month commit for Dedicated if numbers check out.
- Misc links: Fireflies ff_2026-02-08_56789 (transcript), pricing deck in Drive, SEC-4041 ticket for KMS questions.
